I room-ah {num_buttons} button awm a, {buttons}. Button tinrengah Bernoulli distribution pakhat a awm a, a mean chu fixed mahse hriat loh a ni; button tin mean a inang lo thei bawk.
Button tinah, i press chuan, a distribution atanga sample reward i dawng ang.
I nei {num_turns} time steps a, time step tinah, button i duh ber i thlang thei a, reward i dawng ang.
I tum ber chu, time step tinah button i thlang turah dan tha i hmang a, an reward distribution chungchang i hriat theih nan, {num_turns} turns tawp lamah mean reward sang ber nei button i thlang thei tur a ni.
